controls.description: Network documentation includes high-level network diagrams showing all connections into networks and logical network diagrams showing all critical servers, high-value servers, network devices and network security appliances.

controls.title: Control: ism-1912
controls.description: Network documentation includes device settings for all critical servers, high-value servers, network devices and network security appliances.

controls.title: Control: ism-1178
controls.description: Network documentation provided to a third party, or published in public tender documentation, only contains details necessary for other parties to undertake contractual services.

controls.title: Control: ism-1181
controls.description: Networks are segregated into multiple network zones according to the criticality of servers, services and data.

controls.title: Control: ism-1577
controls.description: An organisation’s networks are segregated from their service providers’ networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1532
controls.description: VLANs are not used to separate network traffic between an organisation’s networks and public network infrastructure.

controls.title: Control: ism-0529
controls.description: VLANs are not used to separate network traffic between networks belonging to different security domains.

controls.title: Control: ism-0530
controls.description: Network devices managing VLANs are administered from the most trusted security domain.

controls.title: Control: ism-0535
controls.description: Network devices managing VLANs belonging to different security domains do not share VLAN trunks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1364
controls.description: Network devices managing VLANs terminate VLANs belonging to different security domains on separate physical network interfaces.

controls.title: Control: ism-2068
controls.description: Internet connectivity for networked devices is strictly limited to those that require access.

controls.title: Control: ism-1863
controls.description: Networked management interfaces for IT equipment are not directly exposed to the internet.

controls.title: Control: ism-2160
controls.description: Networked management interfaces for IT equipment are only accessible from a dedicated management network that is segregated from the wider network and the internet.

controls.title: Control: ism-0385
controls.description: Servers maintain effective functional separation from each other.

controls.title: Control: ism-1479
controls.description: Servers minimise communications with other servers at the network and file system level.

controls.title: Control: ism-1781
controls.description: All data communicated over network infrastructure is encrypted using ASD-approved cryptography.

controls.title: Control: ism-1186
controls.description: IPv6 capable network security appliances are used on IPv6 and dual-stack networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1428
controls.description: Unless explicitly required, IPv6 tunnelling is disabled on all network devices.

controls.title: Control: ism-1429
controls.description: IPv6 tunnelling is blocked by network security appliances at externally connected network boundaries.

controls.title: Control: ism-1430
controls.description: Dynamically assigned IPv6 addresses are configured with Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol version 6 in a stateful manner with lease data stored in a centralised event logging facility.

controls.title: Control: ism-0520
controls.description: Network access controls are implemented on networks to prevent the connection of unauthorised network devices and networked IT equipment.

controls.title: Control: ism-1182
controls.description: Network access controls are implemented to limit the flow of network traffic within and between network segments to only that required for business purposes.

controls.title: Control: ism-1321
controls.description: 802.1X with EAP-TLS is used for mutual authentication and key exchange; with all other EAP methods disabled on supplicants and authentication servers.

controls.title: Control: ism-1711
controls.description: User identity confidentiality is used if available with EAP-TLS implementations.

controls.title: Control: ism-1322
controls.description: Evaluated supplicants, authenticators and authentication servers are used for 802.1X authentication implementations.

controls.title: Control: ism-1323
controls.description: X.509 certificates are required for devices and human users authenticating to networks using 802.1X.

controls.title: Control: ism-1324
controls.description: X.509 certificates are generated using an evaluated certificate authority or hardware security module.

controls.title: Control: ism-1327
controls.description: X.509 certificates are protected by logical and physical access controls and encryption, with those issued to human users requiring authentication before use.

controls.title: Control: ism-1454
controls.description: Communications between authenticators and a RADIUS server are encapsulated with an additional layer of encryption using RADIUS over Internet Protocol Security or RADIUS over Transport Layer Security.

controls.title: Control: ism-1006
controls.description: Security measures are implemented to prevent unauthorised access to network management traffic.

controls.title: Control: ism-1962
controls.description: SMB version 1 is not used on networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1311
controls.description: SNMP version 1 and SNMP version 2 are not used on networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1312
controls.description: All default SNMP community strings on network devices are changed and write access is disabled.

controls.title: Control: ism-1028
controls.description: A NIDS or NIPS is deployed in gateways between an organisation’s networks and other networks they do not manage.

controls.title: Control: ism-1030
controls.description: A NIDS or NIPS is located immediately inside the outermost firewall for gateways and configured to generate event logs and alerts for network traffic that contravenes any rule in a firewall ruleset.

controls.title: Control: ism-1627
controls.description: Inbound network connections from anonymity networks are blocked.

controls.title: Control: ism-1628
controls.description: Outbound network connections to anonymity networks are blocked.

controls.title: Control: ism-2017
controls.description: DNS traffic is encrypted by clients and servers using ASD-approved cryptography.

controls.title: Control: ism-1782
controls.description: A protective DNS service is used to block access to known malicious domain names.

controls.title: Control: ism-1800
controls.description: Network devices are flashed with trusted firmware before they are used for the first time.

controls.title: Control: ism-2161
controls.description: The integrity of network device firmware and running configurations is verified against an approved known-good baseline following patching, on detection of anomalous behaviour and at least monthly.

controls.title: Control: ism-1304
controls.description: Default user accounts or credentials for network devices, including for any pre-configured user accounts, are changed, disabled or removed during initial setup.

controls.title: Control: ism-2162
controls.description: Unneeded components, services and functionality of network devices are disabled or removed.

controls.title: Control: ism-0534
controls.description: Unused physical ports on network devices are disabled.

controls.title: Control: ism-1801
controls.description: Network devices are restarted at least monthly.

controls.title: Control: ism-1963
controls.description: Security-relevant events for internet-facing network devices are centrally logged.

controls.title: Control: ism-1964
controls.description: Security-relevant events for non-internet-facing network devices are centrally logged.

controls.title: Control: ism-2163
controls.description: When using MACsec, confidentiality protection mode is enabled using GCM-AES-128, GCM-AES-256, GCM-AES-XPN-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, preferably GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256.

controls.title: Control: ism-2164
controls.description: A connectivity association lifetime of less than 24 hours (86400 seconds) is used for MACsec connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-2165
controls.description: When using EAP-TLS, each device performs a fresh EAP-TLS authentication each time a new Connectivity Association Key is required.

controls.title: Control: ism-2166
controls.description: A secure association lifetime of less than four hours (14400 seconds) is used for MACsec connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-2167
controls.description: The use of a Pre-Shared Key as a fallback authentication method for MACsec is disabled.

controls.title: Control: ism-1314
controls.description: All wireless devices are Wi-Fi Alliance certified.

controls.title: Control: ism-0536
controls.description: Public wireless networks provided for public use are segregated from all other organisation networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1315
controls.description: The administrative interface on wireless access points is disabled for wireless network connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1710
controls.description: Settings for wireless access points are hardened.

controls.title: Control: ism-1316
controls.description: Default SSIDs of wireless access points are changed.

controls.title: Control: ism-1317
controls.description: SSIDs of non-public wireless networks are not readily associated with an organisation, the location of their premises or the functionality of wireless networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1318
controls.description: SSID broadcasting is not disabled on wireless access points.

controls.title: Control: ism-1320
controls.description: MAC address filtering is not used to restrict which devices can connect to wireless networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1319
controls.description: Static addressing is not used for assigning IP addresses on wireless networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1332
controls.description: WPA3-Enterprise 192-bit mode is used to protect the confidentiality and integrity of all wireless network traffic.

controls.title: Control: ism-1330
controls.description: The PMK caching period is not set to greater than 1440 minutes (24 hours).

controls.title: Control: ism-1712
controls.description: The use of FT (802.11r) is disabled unless authenticator-to-authenticator communications are secured by an ASD-Approved Cryptographic Protocol.

controls.title: Control: ism-1334
controls.description: Wireless networks implement sufficient frequency separation from other wireless networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1335
controls.description: Wireless access points enable the use of the 802.11w amendment to protect management frames.

controls.title: Control: ism-1338
controls.description: Instead of deploying a small number of wireless access points that broadcast on high power, a greater number of wireless access points that use less broadcast power are deployed to achieve the desired footprint for wireless networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1013
controls.description: The effective range of wireless communications outside an organisation’s area of control is limited by implementing RF shielding on facilities in which SECRET or TOP SECRET wireless networks are used.

controls.title: Control: ism-1437
controls.description: Cloud service providers are used for hosting online services.

controls.title: Control: ism-1579
controls.description: Cloud service providers’ ability to scale resources dynamically in response to genuine spikes in demand is discussed and verified as part of capacity and availability planning for online services.

controls.title: Control: ism-1580
controls.description: Where a high availability requirement exists for online services, the services are architected to automatically transition between availability zones.

controls.title: Control: ism-1581
controls.description: Continuous real-time monitoring of the capacity and availability of online services is performed.

controls.title: Control: ism-1438
controls.description: Where a high availability requirement exists for website hosting, CDNs that cache websites are used.

controls.title: Control: ism-1439
controls.description: If using CDNs, disclosing the IP addresses of web servers under an organisation’s control (referred to as origin servers) is avoided and access to the origin servers is restricted to the CDNs and authorised management networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1431
controls.description:
Denial-of-service attack mitigation strategies are discussed with cloud service providers, specifically:

- their capacity to withstand denial-of-service attacks
- costs likely to be incurred as a result of denial-of-service attacks
- availability monitoring and thresholds for notification of denial-of-service attacks
- thresholds for turning off any online services or functionality during denial-of-service attacks
- pre-approved actions that can be undertaken during denial-of-service attacks
- any arrangements with upstream service providers to block malicious network traffic as far upstream as possible.

controls.title: Control: ism-1436
controls.description: Critical online services are segregated from other online services that are more likely to be targeted as part of denial-of-service attacks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1432
controls.description: Domain names for online services are protected via registrar locking and confirming that domain registration details are correct.

controls.title: Control: ism-0499
controls.description: Communications security doctrine and policy produced by ASD for the management and operation of HACE is complied with.

controls.title: Control: ism-1802
controls.description: HACE are issued an Approval for Use by ASD and operated in accordance with the latest version of their associated Australian Communications Security Instructions.

controls.title: Control: ism-0507
controls.description: Cryptographic key management processes, and supporting cryptographic key management procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.

controls.title: Control: ism-0457
controls.description: Cryptographic equipment, applications or libraries that have completed a Common Criteria evaluation against an ASD-endorsed Protection Profile are used when encrypting media that contains OFFICIAL: Sensitive or PROTECTED data.

controls.title: Control: ism-0460
controls.description: HACE is used when encrypting media that contains SECRET or TOP SECRET data.

controls.title: Control: ism-0465
controls.description: Cryptographic equipment, applications or libraries that have completed a Common Criteria evaluation against an ASD-endorsed Protection Profile are used to protect OFFICIAL: Sensitive or PROTECTED data when communicated over insufficiently secure networks, outside of appropriately secure areas or via public network infrastructure.

controls.title: Control: ism-0467
controls.description: HACE is used to protect SECRET and TOP SECRET data when communicated over insufficiently secure networks, outside of appropriately secure areas or via public network infrastructure.

controls.title: Control: ism-0455
controls.description: Where practical, cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries provide a means of data recovery to allow for circumstances where the encryption key is unavailable due to loss, damage or failure.

controls.title: Control: ism-0462
controls.description: When a user authenticates to the encryption functionality of IT equipment or media, it is treated in accordance with its original sensitivity or classification until the user deauthenticates from the encryption functionality.

controls.title: Control: ism-0501
controls.description: Keyed cryptographic equipment is transported based on the sensitivity or classification of its keying material.

controls.title: Control: ism-0142
controls.description: The compromise or suspected compromise of cryptographic equipment or associated keying material is reported to the chief information security officer, or one of their delegates, as soon as possible after it occurs.

controls.title: Control: ism-1091
controls.description: Keying material is changed when compromised or suspected of being compromised.

controls.title: Control: ism-1080
controls.description: An AACA or high assurance cryptographic algorithm is used when encrypting data at rest.

controls.title: Control: ism-0471
controls.description: Only AACAs or high assurance cryptographic algorithms are used by cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries.

controls.title: Control: ism-0994
controls.description: ECDH is used in preference to DH.

controls.title: Control: ism-0472
controls.description: When using DH for agreeing on encryption session keys, a modulus of at least 2048 bits is used, preferably 3072 bits.

controls.title: Control: ism-1759
controls.description: When using DH for agreeing on encryption session keys, a modulus of at least 3072 bits is used, preferably 3072 bits.

controls.title: Control: ism-1629
controls.description: When using DH for agreeing on encryption session keys, a modulus and associated parameters are selected according to NIST SP 800-56A Rev. 3.

controls.title: Control: ism-1446
controls.description: When using elliptic curve cryptography, a suitable curve from NIST SP 800-186 is used.

controls.title: Control: ism-0474
controls.description: When using ECDH for agreeing on encryption session keys, a base point order and key size of at least 224 bits is used, preferably the NIST P-384 curve.

controls.title: Control: ism-1761
controls.description: When using ECDH for agreeing on encryption session keys, NIST P-256, P-384 or P-521 curves are used, preferably the NIST P-384 curve.

controls.title: Control: ism-1762
controls.description: When using ECDH for agreeing on encryption session keys, NIST P-384 or P-521 curves are used, preferably the NIST P-384 curve.

controls.title: Control: ism-0475
controls.description: When using ECDSA for digital signatures, a base point order and key size of at least 224 bits is used, preferably the P-384 curve.

controls.title: Control: ism-1763
controls.description: When using ECDSA for digital signatures, NIST P-256, P-384 or P-521 curves are used, preferably the NIST P-384 curve.

controls.title: Control: ism-1764
controls.description: When using ECDSA for digital signatures, NIST P-384 or P-521 curves are used, preferably the NIST P-384 curve.

controls.title: Control: ism-1990
controls.description: When using ML-DSA and ML-KEM, as per FIPS 204 and FIPS 203 respectively, adherence to pre-requisite FIPS 140-3 validation is preferred.

controls.title: Control: ism-1991
controls.description: When using ML-DSA for digital signatures, ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87 is used, preferably ML-DSA-87.

controls.title: Control: ism-1992
controls.description: When using ML-DSA for digital signatures, the hedged variant is used whenever possible.

controls.title: Control: ism-1993
controls.description: Pre-hashed variants of ML-DSA-65 and ML-DSA-87 are only used when the performance of default variants is unacceptable.

controls.title: Control: ism-1994
controls.description: When the pre-hashed variants of ML-DSA-65 and ML-DSA-87 are used, at least SHA-384 and SHA-512 respectively are used for pre-hashing.

controls.title: Control: ism-1995
controls.description: When using ML-KEM for encapsulating encryption session keys (and similar keys), ML-KEM-768 or ML-KEM-1024 is used, preferably ML-KEM-1024.

controls.title: Control: ism-0476
controls.description: When using RSA for digital signatures, and transporting encryption session keys (and similar keys), a modulus of at least 2048 bits is used, preferably 3072 bits.

controls.title: Control: ism-1765
controls.description: When using RSA for digital signatures, and transporting encryption session keys (and similar keys), a modulus of at least 3072 bits is used, preferably 3072 bits.

controls.title: Control: ism-0477
controls.description: When using RSA for digital signatures, and for transporting encryption session keys (and similar keys), a different key pair is used for digital signatures and transporting encryption session keys.

controls.title: Control: ism-1766
controls.description: When using SHA-2 for hashing, an output size of at least 224 bits is used, preferably SHA-384 or SHA-512.

controls.title: Control: ism-1767
controls.description: When using SHA-2 for hashing, an output size of at least 256 bits is used, preferably SHA-384 or SHA-512.

controls.title: Control: ism-1768
controls.description: When using SHA-2 for hashing, an output size of at least 384 bits is used, preferably SHA-384 or SHA-512.

controls.title: Control: ism-1769
controls.description: When using AES for encryption, AES-128, AES-192 or AES-256 is used, preferably AES-256.

controls.title: Control: ism-1770
controls.description: When using AES for encryption, AES-192 or AES-256 is used, preferably AES-256.

controls.title: Control: ism-0479
controls.description: Symmetric cryptographic algorithms are not used in Electronic Codebook Mode.

controls.title: Control: ism-2073
controls.description: A post-quantum cryptography transition plan is developed, implemented and maintained.

controls.title: Control: ism-1917
controls.description: The development and procurement of new cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries ensures support for the use of ML-DSA-87, ML-KEM-1024, SHA-384, SHA-512 and AES-256 by no later than 2030.

controls.title: Control: ism-1996
controls.description: When a post-quantum traditional hybrid scheme is used, either the post-quantum cryptographic algorithm, the traditional cryptographic algorithm or both are AACAs.

controls.title: Control: ism-0469
controls.description: An AACP or high assurance cryptographic protocol is used when encrypting data in transit.

controls.title: Control: ism-0481
controls.description: Only AACPs or high assurance cryptographic protocols are used by cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries.

controls.title: Control: ism-0494
controls.description: Tunnel mode is used for IPsec connections; however, if using transport mode, an IP tunnel is used.

controls.title: Control: ism-0496
controls.description: The ESP protocol is used for authentication and encryption of IPsec connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1233
controls.description: IKE version 2 is used for key exchange when establishing IPsec connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1771
controls.description: AES is used for encrypting IPsec connections, preferably ENCR_AES_GCM_16.

controls.title: Control: ism-1772
controls.description: PRF_HMAC_SHA2_256, PRF_HMAC_SHA2_384 or PRF_HMAC_SHA2_512 is used for IPsec connections, preferably PRF_HMAC_SHA2_512.

controls.title: Control: ism-0998
controls.description: AUTH_HMAC_SHA2_256_128, AUTH_HMAC_SHA2_384_192, AUTH_HMAC_SHA2_512_256 or NONE (only with AES-GCM) is used for authenticating IPsec connections, preferably NONE.

controls.title: Control: ism-0999
controls.description: DH or ECDH is used for key establishment of IPsec connections, preferably 384-bit random ECP group, 3072-bit MODP Group or 4096-bit MODP Group.

controls.title: Control: ism-0498
controls.description: A security association lifetime of less than four hours (14400 seconds) is used for IPsec connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1000
controls.description: PFS is used for IPsec connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1506
controls.description: The use of SSH version 1 is disabled for SSH connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-0484
controls.description:
The SSH daemon is configured to:

- only listen on the required interfaces (ListenAddress xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx)
- have a suitable login banner (Banner x)
- have a login authentication timeout of no more than 60 seconds (LoginGraceTime 60)
- disable host-based authentication (HostbasedAuthentication no)
- disable rhosts-based authentication (IgnoreRhosts yes)
- disable the ability to log in directly as root (PermitRootLogin no)
- disable empty passwords (PermitEmptyPasswords no)
- disable connection forwarding (AllowTCPForwarding no)
- disable gateway ports (GatewayPorts no)
- disable X11 forwarding (X11Forwarding no).

controls.title: Control: ism-0485
controls.description: Public key-based authentication is used for SSH connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1449
controls.description: SSH private keys are protected with a password or a key encryption key.

controls.title: Control: ism-0487
controls.description:
When using logins without a password for SSH connections, the following are disabled:

- access from IP addresses that do not require access
- port forwarding
- agent credential forwarding
- X11 forwarding
- console access.

controls.title: Control: ism-0488
controls.description: If using remote access without the use of a password for SSH connections, the ‘forced command’ option is used to specify what command is executed and parameter checking is enabled.

controls.title: Control: ism-0489
controls.description: When SSH-agent or similar key caching applications are used, cached private keys have a maximum lifetime of four hours and, where applicable, screen locks are used on workstations and servers.

controls.title: Control: ism-0490
controls.description: Versions of S/MIME earlier than S/MIME version 3.0 are not used for S/MIME connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1139
controls.description: Only the latest version of TLS is used for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1369
controls.description: AES-GCM is used for encryption of TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1370
controls.description: Only server-initiated secure renegotiation is used for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1372
controls.description: The ephemeral variant of DH or ECDH is used for key establishment of TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1373
controls.description: Anonymous DH is not used for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1374
controls.description: SHA-2-based certificates are used for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1375
controls.description: SHA-2 is used for the Hash-based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) and pseudorandom function (PRF) for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1553
controls.description: TLS compression is disabled for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-1453
controls.description: Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) is used for TLS connections.

controls.title: Control: ism-0628
controls.description: Gateways are implemented between networks belonging to different security domains.

controls.title: Control: ism-0637
controls.description: Gateways implement a demilitarised zone if external parties require access to an organisation’s services.

controls.title: Control: ism-0631
controls.description: Gateways only allow explicitly authorised data flows.

controls.title: Control: ism-1192
controls.description: Gateways inspect and filter data flows at the transport and above network layers.

controls.title: Control: ism-1427
controls.description: Gateways perform ingress traffic filtering to detect and prevent IP source address spoofing.

controls.title: Control: ism-1520
controls.description: System administrators for gateways undergo appropriate employment screening, and where necessary hold an appropriate security clearance, based on the sensitivity or classification of gateways.

controls.title: Control: ism-0613
controls.description: System administrators for gateways that connect to Australian Eyes Only or Releasable To networks are Australian nationals.

controls.title: Control: ism-1773
controls.description: System administrators for gateways that connect to Australian Government Access Only networks are Australian nationals or seconded foreign nationals.

controls.title: Control: ism-0611
controls.description: System administrators for gateways are assigned the minimum privileges required to perform their duties.

controls.title: Control: ism-0616
controls.description: Separation of duties is implemented in performing administrative activities for gateways.

controls.title: Control: ism-0612
controls.description: System administrators for gateways are formally trained on the operation and management of gateways.

controls.title: Control: ism-1774
controls.description: Gateways are managed via a secure path isolated from all connected networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-0629
controls.description: For gateways between networks belonging to different security domains, any shared components are managed by system administrators for the higher security domain or by system administrators from a mutually agreed upon third party.

controls.title: Control: ism-0619
controls.description: Users authenticate to other networks accessed via gateways.

controls.title: Control: ism-0622
controls.description: IT equipment authenticates to other networks accessed via gateways.

controls.title: Control: ism-1783
controls.description: Public IP addresses controlled by, or used by, an organisation are signed by valid ROA records.

controls.title: Control: ism-2018
controls.description: Routes for RPKI-registered IP addresses that are advertised from invalid Autonomous Systems, or that are longer than allowed, are rejected or deprioritised by routers that exchange routes via BGP.

controls.title: Control: ism-0634
controls.description:
Security-relevant events for gateways are centrally logged, including:

- data packets and data flows permitted through gateways
- data packets and data flows attempting to leave gateways
- real-time alerts for attempted intrusions.

controls.title: Control: ism-1037
controls.description: Gateways undergo testing following configuration changes, and at regular intervals no more than six months apart, to validate that they conform to expected security configurations.

controls.title: Control: ism-0100
controls.description: Non-classified, OFFICIAL: Sensitive, PROTECTED and SECRET gateways undergo an IRAP assessment, using the latest release of the ISM available prior to the beginning of the IRAP assessment (or a subsequent release), at least every 24 months.

controls.title: Control: ism-2019
controls.description: TOP SECRET gateways undergo a security control assessment by ASD assessors (or their delegates), using the latest release of the ISM available prior to the beginning of the assessment (or a subsequent release), at least every 24 months.

controls.title: Control: ism-0626
controls.description: CDSs are implemented between SECRET or TOP SECRET networks and any other networks belonging to different security domains.

controls.title: Control: ism-0597
controls.description: When planning, designing, implementing or introducing additional connectivity to CDSs, ASD is consulted and any directions provided by ASD are complied with.

controls.title: Control: ism-0635
controls.description: CDSs implement isolated upward and downward network paths.

controls.title: Control: ism-1522
controls.description: CDSs implement independent security-enforcing functions for upward and downward network paths.

controls.title: Control: ism-1521
controls.description: CDSs implement protocol breaks at each network layer.

controls.title: Control: ism-0610
controls.description: Human users are trained on the secure use of CDSs before access is granted.

controls.title: Control: ism-0670
controls.description: Security-relevant events for CDSs are centrally logged.

controls.title: Control: ism-1523
controls.description: A sample of security-relevant events relating to data transfer policies are taken at least every three months and assessed against security policies for CDSs to identify any operational failures.

controls.title: Control: ism-1528
controls.description: Evaluated firewalls are used between an organisation’s networks and public network infrastructure.

controls.title: Control: ism-0639
controls.description: Evaluated firewalls are used between networks belonging to different security domains.

controls.title: Control: ism-1862
controls.description: If using a WAF, disclosing the IP addresses of web servers under an organisation’s control (referred to as origin servers) is avoided and access to the origin servers is restricted to the WAF and authorised management networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-0643
controls.description: Evaluated diodes are used for controlling the data flow of unidirectional gateways between an organisation’s networks and public network infrastructure.

controls.title: Control: ism-0645
controls.description: Evaluated diodes used for controlling the data flow of unidirectional gateways between SECRET or TOP SECRET networks and public network infrastructure complete a high assurance evaluation.

controls.title: Control: ism-1157
controls.description: Evaluated diodes are used for controlling the data flow of unidirectional gateways between networks.

controls.title: Control: ism-1158
controls.description: Evaluated diodes used for controlling the data flow of unidirectional gateways between SECRET or TOP SECRET networks and any other networks complete a high assurance evaluation.

controls.title: Control: ism-0260
controls.description: All web access, including that by internal servers, is conducted through web proxies.

controls.title: Control: ism-0261
controls.description:
The following details are centrally logged for websites accessed via web proxies:

- web address
